scope: Frontend-only specialist audit of plan121/124/126/132/133. Source inspection plus six GET-only fixture workflows; no application source edits or backend writes.

priority_findings.finding: Legacy header selects the final designation array entry without checking effective dates. A future2099 designation is shown as current identity while workspace Overview shows the actual current position. Workspace computes a position in render but does not display that value in the header.
priority_findings.safe_frontend_fix: Use the already-returned profile.today to date-filter legacy header designation, keeping source ordering as the tie-breaker; use truthful Position not recorded when none is current. Do not change designation records or eligibility. Consider a shared visual identity header while preserving existing role gates and actions.
priority_findings.bounded_runtime: All three engines at320/1280 reproduce Future reviewer position in legacy header versus Current reviewer position in workspace Overview.
priority_findings.acceptance: Check past-only,current,future-only,current+future,empty histories; current label must match effective dates, all full names/designations escaped and wrapped, Close stays visible and keyboard reachable. Existing request paths and role-specific controls unchanged.

priority_findings.finding: History renderer applies value??Ongoing to every null scalar. Fixture null unit and null notes therefore display Ongoing, inventing duration semantics for missing identity/text fields.
priority_findings.safe_frontend_fix: Use Ongoing only for known open-ended date fields such as ends_on/effective_to. Use neutral Not recorded for other null scalar values, retaining all nonnull values, zeroes, booleans and raw IDs. Avoid guessing special-posting semantics for a missing unit.
priority_findings.bounded_runtime: All six contexts render unit=Ongoing,notes=Ongoing,ends_on=Ongoing. Null values were injected in GET fixture only; production prevalence not certified.
priority_findings.acceptance: GET fixtures for null unit/notes/date,zero,false,empty strings and escaped labels. Verify ends_on remains Ongoing, other nulls truthfully unrecorded, exact nonnull values preserved; no mutation or request changes.

additional_findings.finding: Legacy header lacks the workspace min-width0/anywhere wrapping treatment. Long unbroken surname fixture causes header and dialog horizontal overflow in all six contexts, though measured name and Close rectangles do not overlap.
additional_findings.safe_frontend_fix: Scope min-width0 to legacy header identity column, overflow-wrap:anywhere to name/designation and flex-shrink0 to Close. Test320/1280 light/dark and enlarged text with no dialog horizontal overflow.

other_reviewed_items.assessment: Workspace labels/order are centralized in labels. Legacy profile uses a different section/disclosure hierarchy. Counts are absent in tab labels; avoid adding misleading zeroes or new reads solely to populate counts. Full cross-entry acceptance remains open.

Workspace Duties already renders returned official-analysis numbers and actual duty records in the same view, with date filters. This audit does not certify all workload metrics or their backend meaning.
